chunks: All things they do are (recorded) in the books;
ai.seo_question: What does the term 'Zubur' refer to in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this segment highlights the comprehensive recording of deeds, linking the 'Zubur' (plural of Zabur) to the divine books revealed to prophets, particularly David. It underscores the concept of 'Kitabat al-A'mal' (writing of deeds), affirming that every action, whether great or small, is meticulously preserved in heavenly records for the final accounting. This reinforces the Shia emphasis on the continuity of divine revelation and the precision of divine justice in evaluating human conduct.
